requirementsManagement.idPolicy: Immutable {CATEGORY}-{NNN} identifiers; corrections append or supersede and never reuse an ID.
requirementsManagement.changePolicy: Material changes require impact assessment, human confirmation, a new candidate hash set and renewed assurance; an approved baseline is never overwritten.
requirementsManagement.acceptancePolicy: Every active requirement has a stable test ID, precondition, action or input, observable outcome, threshold, environment and evidence source.

requirements.statement: Release 1 shall reduce the median end-to-end due-diligence cycle for eligible new investment opportunities from 12 weeks to no more than 3 weeks within 12 months of programme approval.
requirements.rationale: This is the confirmed accountable business outcome.

acceptance.precondition: Twenty eligible Release 1 deals have completed with required control evidence.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Calculate cycle duration from formal case-opening to investment-committee-ready workflow timestamps.
acceptance.observableOutcome: The median duration is no more than 21 calendar days and control exceptions are reported.
acceptance.threshold: Median <= 3 weeks across the first 20 eligible completed deals.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Workflow timestamps, eligibility records, control-exception register and CIO acceptance.

requirements.statement: Release 1 shall be limited to the first 20 eligible new private-equity investment opportunities, with deal eligibility owned by the Head of Deal Operations and jurisdiction eligibility owned by General Counsel.
requirements.rationale: The human confirmed a controlled production rollout rather than unrestricted deployment.

acceptance.precondition: A candidate deal is proposed for Release 1.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Apply the approved deal and jurisdiction eligibility checks.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Only an approved eligible deal is admitted, and rollout stops at 20 completed eligible deals pending acceptance.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of admitted deals have recorded deal and jurisdiction eligibility.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Eligibility approvals and rollout register.

requirements.statement: Release 1 shall support governed evidence ingestion, retrieval, extraction, comparison, anomaly flagging, risk analysis, ESG analysis, source citation, human review and preparation of an investment-committee-ready draft recommendation.
requirements.rationale: These are the confirmed in-scope workflow functions.

acceptance.precondition: An eligible deal has governed source evidence.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Execute the Release 1 due-diligence workflow.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Each included function is available and produces a reviewable draft with source evidence.
acceptance.threshold: All listed functions demonstrated for an approved representative case.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Workflow demonstration, audit events and approved output.

requirements.statement: Release 1 shall require deal-professional validation of source evidence and material outputs, and General Counsel and Compliance approval of regulated, legal, sanctions or externally sourced conclusions, before investment use.
requirements.rationale: Human validation and specialist approvals are mandatory.

acceptance.precondition: A material output or specialist conclusion is produced.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Attempt to progress the output without the applicable review.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Progress is blocked until the named review is recorded.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of material outputs and applicable specialist conclusions have auditable approvals.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Workflow approval and audit records.

requirements.statement: AI shall operate only as an assistive capability and shall not issue final investment recommendations, alter authoritative sources, disclose information externally, execute transactions, make approval decisions or bypass legal, compliance, security or human review.
requirements.rationale: The confirmed AI-control boundary retains material decisions with humans.

acceptance.precondition: Approved negative-test prompts and attempted prohibited actions are available.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Exercise every prohibited action path.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Each action is prevented and logged without side effect.
acceptance.threshold: 100% prevention of prohibited actions; zero critical breach.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Negative-test results and immutable audit log.

requirements.statement: The Investment Committee shall retain every investment decision; Release 1 outputs shall remain drafts until the required human reviews are complete.
requirements.rationale: Investment authority is explicitly retained by the Investment Committee.

acceptance.precondition: A draft recommendation exists.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Inspect its status and attempt automated approval.
acceptance.observableOutcome: The output remains a draft and automated approval is unavailable.
acceptance.threshold: Zero system-issued investment decisions.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Workflow state, permissions and committee decision record.

requirements.statement: Release 1 shall use only governed deal-room and document-management, deal pipeline and CRM, portfolio and financial, ESG, legal and compliance records owned by the confirmed source owners.
requirements.rationale: The permitted internal data domains and owners are confirmed.

acceptance.precondition: A source is proposed for ingestion.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Validate its domain, authoritative-system status and owner.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Only a governed source with a confirmed owner is admitted.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of ingested internal sources are approved and owner-bound.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Source register and ingestion approval.

requirements.owner: General Counsel and relevant data owner
requirements.statement: External market, company, patent, sanctions and regulatory data shall be used only when its licence explicitly permits AI-assisted retrieval and analysis.
requirements.rationale: External-data use is conditional on confirmed licensing rights.

acceptance.precondition: An external dataset is proposed.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Review and record its licence terms.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Use is blocked unless AI-assisted retrieval and analysis are explicitly permitted.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of external sources have an approved licence record.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Licence register and legal approval.

requirements.statement: Personal data shall be minimised and purpose-limited; special-category data shall be excluded unless separately approved through change control.
requirements.rationale: The human confirmed minimisation, purpose limitation and an explicit Release 1 exclusion.

acceptance.precondition: A data field or document class is proposed.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Apply personal-data and purpose screening.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Unnecessary personal data and all unapproved special-category data are rejected or removed.
acceptance.threshold: Zero unapproved special-category records; documented purpose for retained personal data.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Data inventory, screening record and approval log.

requirements.statement: Every ingested item shall retain source provenance, owner, timestamp, licence and quality status.
requirements.rationale: These metadata are required for traceability, lawful use and reproducibility.

acceptance.precondition: An item is ingested.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Inspect mandatory metadata.
acceptance.observableOutcome: The item is unavailable to AI processing until every mandatory field is populated.
acceptance.threshold: 100% metadata completeness.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Data catalogue and ingestion validation log.

requirements.statement: Authoritative source-system retention schedules and legal holds shall govern retained records; temporary AI working copies shall be deleted when no longer required.
requirements.rationale: The confirmed decision avoids inventing a new retention period.

acceptance.precondition: A retained record or temporary working copy reaches its disposition event.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Apply the source schedule, legal hold and working-copy deletion rule.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Held or scheduled records are preserved and unnecessary working copies are deleted.
acceptance.threshold: 100% disposition events produce auditable outcomes.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Retention mapping, legal-hold register and deletion log.

requirements.statement: Stratton data shall not be used to train foundation models.
requirements.rationale: This is an explicit confirmed data-use prohibition.

acceptance.precondition: A model configuration or provider data-use setting is proposed.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Inspect training and data-use configuration and contracts.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Foundation-model training with Stratton data is disabled and contractually prohibited.
acceptance.threshold: Zero training use of Stratton data.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Configuration evidence, contract terms and audit record.

requirements.owner: Respective data owner and Chief Information Security Officer
requirements.statement: Deal, financial, legal and portfolio data shall be classified as highly confidential and handled in accordance with the confirmed access, production-isolation, residency, transfer, audit and retention boundaries.
requirements.rationale: The highly-confidential classification and its handling boundary were explicitly confirmed.

acceptance.precondition: Deal, financial, legal or portfolio data is proposed for ingestion or access.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Inspect its classification and the applicable handling-control evidence.
acceptance.observableOutcome: The data is labelled highly confidential and every confirmed handling boundary is enforced.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of in-scope items have the classification and complete applicable control evidence.
acceptance.environment: All environments, with production-confidential data permitted only in production.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Data catalogue, access evidence, location and transfer records, audit log and retention mapping.

requirements.statement: Production data, backups, logs, model inputs and outputs, and routine processing shall remain in approved EU/EEA locations.
requirements.rationale: This is the confirmed sovereignty residency boundary.

acceptance.precondition: Production deployment and data flows are defined.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Inspect configured locations and observed processing paths.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Every listed data and processing class remains in an approved EU/EEA location.
acceptance.threshold: 100% compliant location evidence; zero unapproved location.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Resource inventory, data-flow evidence, configuration and audit logs.

requirements.owner: General Counsel and Data Protection Officer
requirements.statement: Transfers outside the EEA shall be prohibited unless General Counsel and the Data Protection Officer approve a documented legal mechanism, purpose and risk assessment.
requirements.rationale: The human confirmed a controlled exception rather than an absolute architectural assumption.

acceptance.precondition: An extra-EEA transfer is attempted or proposed.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Evaluate the transfer gate.
acceptance.observableOutcome: The transfer is blocked absent both approvals and complete evidence.
acceptance.threshold: Zero unapproved extra-EEA transfer.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Transfer register, approval record and risk assessment.

requirements.owner: Data Protection Officer and General Counsel
requirements.statement: Release 1 personal-data processing shall have a documented lawful basis, purpose limitation, data-subject handling, DPIA screening, processor controls and transfer governance.
requirements.rationale: These are the confirmed GDPR constraints.

acceptance.precondition: A personal-data processing activity is proposed.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Review its privacy evidence pack.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Processing is blocked until every applicable evidence item is approved.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of personal-data activities have complete approved evidence.
acceptance.environment: Before production and on material change.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Record of processing, lawful-basis record, DPIA screening and processor evidence.

requirements.statement: Where ESG outputs support regulated SFDR disclosures, Release 1 shall provide data lineage, quality status, reproducibility, accountable review and audit evidence.
requirements.rationale: This is the confirmed conditional SFDR requirement boundary.

acceptance.precondition: An ESG output is identified for regulated disclosure support.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Reproduce the output and inspect its evidence chain.
acceptance.observableOutcome: The result is reproducible and has complete lineage, quality, review and audit evidence.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of such outputs satisfy all evidence fields.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Lineage record, quality record, reproduction result and approval log.

requirements.statement: Where Luxembourg AIF vehicles use Release 1, governed risk and documentation records shall be retained according to the applicable authoritative schedule.
requirements.rationale: This is the confirmed conditional AIFMD boundary without inventing a retention period.

acceptance.precondition: An eligible Luxembourg AIF vehicle uses Release 1.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Inspect risk, documentation and retention mapping.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Required records are governed and mapped to the applicable approved schedule.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of applicable cases have complete records and schedule mapping.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Vehicle eligibility, records inventory and retention mapping.

requirements.owner: General Counsel and Head of AI Governance
requirements.statement: Release 1 shall provide AI literacy, transparency, human oversight, logging, risk management and documented role and use-case classification evidence; it shall not claim high-risk or non-high-risk status without that assessment.
requirements.rationale: The confirmed EU AI Act position requires governance while preserving classification uncertainty until documented.

acceptance.precondition: Release 1 is proposed for production or materially changed.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Review the AI governance evidence pack.
acceptance.observableOutcome: All governance evidence exists and classification claims match the approved assessment.
acceptance.threshold: Complete approved evidence before production and after material change.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Training, transparency, oversight, logs, risk register and classification assessment.

requirements.statement: Privileged administration and operational access shall use Stratton-controlled identities, be limited to authorised EU-based personnel, enforce least privilege and time-bound elevation, remain completely auditable, and use an approved emergency-access process.
requirements.rationale: These are the confirmed privileged-access sovereignty controls.

acceptance.precondition: Privileged or emergency access is requested.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Exercise normal and emergency access paths.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Only authorised EU-based identities receive time-bound least-privilege access and all actions are logged.
acceptance.threshold: 100% compliant access events; zero unauthorised event.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Identity, elevation, location, access-review and audit records.

requirements.statement: Internal Audit shall issue the independent Release 1 validation verdict; Model Risk shall define and advise on validation methods but shall not issue the independent verdict.
requirements.rationale: The confirmed separation preserves organisational independence.

acceptance.precondition: Release 1 acceptance evidence is complete.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Review validator identity, independence and signed verdict.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Internal Audit independently issues the verdict using documented methods and evidence.
acceptance.threshold: One independent verdict from Internal Audit; no verdict issued by Model Risk.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Appointment, independence statement, method and validation verdict.

requirements.statement: Pending the entity-specific DORA applicability or exemption record, Release 1 shall support DORA-aligned ICT risk management, incident evidence, resilience testing and third-party and cloud oversight, and shall not claim formal DORA compliance.
requirements.rationale: This is the confirmed interim boundary; it does not invent entity-specific applicability or formal compliance.

acceptance.precondition: Release 1 is presented for production or assurance.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Inspect the ICT, incident, resilience and third-party evidence and public/internal compliance claims.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Evidence is present, claims remain DORA-aligned rather than formally compliant, and the legal validation item remains visible until resolved.
acceptance.threshold: No formal compliance claim before General Counsel records applicability or exemption.
acceptance.evidenceSource: ICT risk record, incident evidence, resilience tests, provider oversight and legal decision record.

requirements.statement: Contracts, data processing, incident handling and dispute governance shall remain subject to applicable EU and member-state law; any foreign-jurisdiction exposure shall be explicitly assessed and accepted by General Counsel before use.
requirements.rationale: This is the confirmed legal-jurisdiction sovereignty outcome.

acceptance.precondition: A contract, processing arrangement, incident process, dispute term or provider introduces potential foreign-jurisdiction exposure.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Review governing-law terms and the foreign-exposure assessment.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Applicable EU or member-state governance is documented and any foreign exposure has explicit General Counsel acceptance.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of identified foreign-jurisdiction exposures have a documented assessment and acceptance before use.
acceptance.environment: Procurement, pre-production and material change control.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Contract record, governing-law analysis, exposure assessment and General Counsel acceptance.

requirements.statement: Release 1 shall integrate with authoritative systems only through approved read-only APIs or controlled ingestion and shall not write AI-generated content into source records.
requirements.rationale: This preserves source authority and the confirmed no-write-back boundary.

acceptance.precondition: Each source interface is configured.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Review permissions and attempt AI-generated write-back.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Reads or controlled ingestion succeed and write-back is denied.
acceptance.threshold: Zero AI-generated source-record writes.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Interface configuration, permission test and source audit log.

requirements.statement: Development, test and production environments shall be separated; development and test shall use synthetic data, and production-confidential data shall remain only in production.
requirements.rationale: Environment and data isolation are confirmed.

acceptance.precondition: All environments are provisioned.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Inspect isolation, access and representative datasets.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Environments are separated and no production-confidential data exists outside production.
acceptance.threshold: Zero production-confidential records in development or test.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Inventory, access configuration and data scan.

requirements.statement: Migration shall be incremental with reconciliation and parallel operation for the first three eligible deals; big-bang replacement is prohibited.
requirements.rationale: This is the confirmed migration-risk treatment.

acceptance.precondition: Each of the first three eligible deals completes.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Reconcile Release 1 output and the authoritative process during parallel operation.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Differences are recorded and resolved before progression.
acceptance.threshold: Three completed reconciliations; no big-bang cutover.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Migration plan, reconciliation records and go/no-go decisions.

requirements.statement: Production shall meet 99.9% availability during approved business hours, a recovery time objective of 4 hours and a recovery point objective of 1 hour.
requirements.rationale: These service and recovery targets are confirmed.

acceptance.precondition: Business hours are approved and production monitoring and recovery procedures are active.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Measure availability and execute an approved recovery test.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Availability and recovery results meet all targets.
acceptance.threshold: Availability >= 99.9% during approved business hours; RTO <= 4 hours; RPO <= 1 hour.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Monitoring report and recovery-test record.

requirements.statement: Production shall provide 8x5 support, monitored critical alerts and named incident ownership.
requirements.rationale: The support operating model is confirmed.

acceptance.precondition: Support service and alerting are configured.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Trigger an approved critical-alert test during support hours.
acceptance.observableOutcome: The alert is monitored and assigned to a named incident owner.
acceptance.threshold: 100% of critical test alerts are detected and assigned.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Support rota, alert record and incident assignment.

requirements.statement: Release 1 AI quality shall achieve 100% governed citation coverage for material claims, at least 95% field-level extraction accuracy, at least 99% accuracy for critical financial and legal fields, zero critical unsupported claims, no more than 2% unsupported non-critical claims, at least 90% recall for seeded high-risk findings and no missed critical risk.
requirements.rationale: These are the confirmed measurable AI quality thresholds.

acceptance.precondition: The approved representative benchmark and severity definitions are available.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Run citation, extraction, unsupported-claim and seeded-risk evaluations.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Every metric meets its confirmed threshold.
acceptance.threshold: 100% citations; >=95% extraction; >=99% critical-field accuracy; 0 critical unsupported claims; <=2% non-critical unsupported claims; >=90% high-risk recall; 0 critical risks missed.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Benchmark definition, evaluation results and Internal Audit verdict.

requirements.statement: Release 1 shall prevent 100% of approved prohibited-action negative tests and retain auditable human review for every material output.
requirements.rationale: These are the confirmed safety and audit thresholds.

acceptance.precondition: Approved negative tests and material-output cases are available.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Execute all tests and inspect all review trails.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Every prohibited action is blocked and every material output has a complete review trail.
acceptance.threshold: 100% prevention and 100% auditable review.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Negative-test report, audit trail and Internal Audit verdict.

requirements.statement: Production shall provide p95 interactive response below 5 seconds and process a typical due-diligence document pack within 30 minutes.
requirements.rationale: These are the confirmed performance targets.

acceptance.precondition: The typical document-pack profile and representative load are approved.
acceptance.actionOrInput: Run interactive and pack-processing performance tests.
acceptance.observableOutcome: Both performance measures meet their targets.
acceptance.threshold: p95 interactive response < 5 seconds; typical pack processing <= 30 minutes.
acceptance.evidenceSource: Approved workload profile and performance report.

nonScope: Special-category personal data without separately approved change control
Wider production rollout before Release 1 acceptance criteria pass

validationItems.item: Record the relevant entity, DORA trigger, applicability or exemption and resulting obligations.
validationItems.plan: Complete before any formal DORA compliance claim; update the regulatory register and requirements through change control if the decision changes scope.

validationItems.item: Define approved business hours, typical document-pack characteristics and critical-alert criteria.
validationItems.owner: Chief Investment Officer and Service Operations
validationItems.plan: Approve definitions before service and performance acceptance tests.

validationItems.item: Define eligible-deal criteria, benchmark eligibility, critical-field classification, unsupported-claim severity and control-exception handling.
validationItems.owner: Head of Deal Operations, Head of AI Governance, General Counsel, Compliance and Chief Investment Officer
validationItems.plan: Approve the test-data and measurement specification before Internal Audit validation.

validationItems.item: Identify exact authoritative system instances, retention schedules, expected volumes and production data-quality remediation procedures.
validationItems.owner: Respective source owners and records owners
validationItems.plan: Complete the source register and operational mappings before production ingestion.

validationItems.item: Obtain General Counsel's final confirmation of the approved EU/EEA location list and sovereignty exception evidence process.
validationItems.plan: Retain the signed decision before production location and transfer acceptance.
